end.summary:
• Identified the court hierarchy: District Court → High Court → Supreme Court.
• Explained appeal as moving to a higher court for another hearing.
• Practised distinguishing civil and criminal cases; one of two attempts was correct.
• Discussed Lok Adalat, compromise, judges, lawyers, and free legal aid.
• Teach-back was not passed; Vihaan requested concrete examples and courtroom details.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the court structure and the idea of appeal with Vihaan, using the bottom-to-top court pathway. Vihaan explained the appeal route clearly and used a water-sharing dispute to explore civil cases. They were still unsure about classifying a car accident and about how Lok Adalat and free legal aid work; these points were not confirmed as corrected by the end. At home, discuss one everyday dispute and one crime, then ask which type of case each might be and why.
